<!--skill-flavor:flow-format-version-source:start-->
**Top-level `version`** = workflow file-format version. Preserve the exact value in the `.flow` entrypoint generated by Studio Web's `CreateProjects` operation. The schema gates on an exact literal for the current file-format version, so an older value that worked for a legacy parser can fail for a new Flow.
<!--skill-flavor:flow-format-version-source:end-->

<!--skill-flavor:minimal-example-version-source:start-->
Replace `<uuid>` with any generated UUID (e.g. `crypto.randomUUID()` in Node.js, or any UUID v4 generator) for the top-level flow `id` and `entryPointId`; use the same UUID in `entry-points.json` as `uniqueId`. Start node and edge ids with a letter (see the Edge gotcha above). Preserve the top-level `version` from the host-generated `.flow` entrypoint (see [Top-level structure](#top-level-structure)).
<!--skill-flavor:minimal-example-version-source:end-->
